America's #1 Calculator App! Download Calculator₊ Now - Your All-in-One Math Solution!

We're excited to announce the biggest update to Calculator₊ in 10 years! With over 200 million downloads and a whopping 3 million+ 5-star ratings, Calculator₊ is the trusted choice of millions worldwide. And now, it's even better!

More Than Just Your Average Calculator!

• Standard Calculator: Breeze through basic arithmetic operations like addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
• Scientific Calculator: Tackle complex calculations with ease, including trigonometric, logarithmic, and exponential functions.
• Calculation History: Keep track of your past calculations with a detailed history log.
• Unit Converter: Effortlessly convert units like inches to centimeters and much more, making it a handy tool for everyday use.
• Percentage Calculator: Easily calculate percentages, increases, and decreases with pre-designed input fields that do the work for you.
• Currency Converter: Convert currencies in real-time, including Bitcoin, with the latest exchange rates.
• Fraction Calculator: Work seamlessly with fractions – perfect for students and professionals alike.
• Ad-Free Experience: Say goodbye to annoying full-screen ads and focus on your calculations.

Be Amazed by Our New AI-Powered Math Solver!

• AI Math Solutions: Instantly solve math equations, quizzes, and word problems with our advanced AI. Use the Photo Solver to snap a picture of any problem, and Calculator₊ will work its magic.
• Math Notes: A dedicated note-taking tool for all your math needs. Jot down equations, diagrams, and notes in a space designed for mathematical thinking.
• Instant Math: In Math Notes mode, simply write an equation, add an "=", and Calculator₊ will generate the solution in real-time.

Built for Everyone, Now Even More Accessible!

Calculator₊ is designed to work effortlessly for all users, no matter how you use your iPhone, and includes these additional accessibility features:

• Dynamic Text Size: Scale the calculator interface to the text size that works best for you, without losing layout clarity.
• VoiceOver Support: Navigate & Calculate using VoiceOver, fully compatible with iOS accessibility settings.
• High-Contrast Mode: A bold, high-contrast display that makes every button and result instantly readable in any lighting condition.
• Dark and Light Mode: Calculator₊ automatically adjusts to your preferred mode.

Why Choose Calculator₊?

• Proven Track Record: Over a decade of providing fast and reliable calculations.
• Loved by Millions: Join the 200+ million users who rely on Calculator₊, with an average rating of 4.7 stars from 3.5 million reviews.
• Versatile & Powerful: Handles everything from basic sums to advanced scientific calculations. Perfect for school, work, or home.

Celebrate with a Special Gift!

To celebrate the release of this massive update, we're offering a 1-MONTH FREE TRIAL of our premium features, including:

• Ad-Free Experience: No more pesky ads.
• Unlimited AI Math Solving: Solve as many equations and problems as you need.
• Unlimited Fraction Calculations: Ideal for students and professionals alike.
• Unlimited Currency Conversions: Including real-time Bitcoin conversions.
• Premium Customer Support: Get priority assistance from our expert support team.

If you have any suggestions or questions, our support team is ready to help. Simply email us at support@impalastudios.com.
